permissions.toml.label: Permissions Rules File
permissions.toml.help: Supports tool + optional command/path fields. Matching rules force approval in non-YOLO mode; in never mode, matches are directly rejected (because no popup can be shown).

approval_policy.label: Approval Policy
approval_policy.help: Popup approval strategy before tool execution. on-request confirms each request, untrusted only confirms untrusted operations, never never pops up.

sandbox_mode.label: Sandbox Mode
sandbox_mode.help: File system access sandbox. read-only is the strictest, workspace-write allows writes within the workspace, danger-full-access has no limits, external-sandbox relies on external tool isolation.

allow_shell.label: Allow Shell
allow_shell.help: Whether to allow shell tools. Available when true, but still controlled by approval_policy; false completely hides the exec_shell tool.
